name: @psyb0t/imagies
summary: Connect an agent to a self-hosted Imagies server over MCP.
description: Crop, resize and convert with transform, make a grid with montage, rank text queries with match, find objects with detect, and generate images with generate. Run Imagies and supply its URL. https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-imagies

IMAGIES_URL.description: Base URL of your running Imagies instance. The bridge appends /v1/mcp.

IMAGIES_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token when authentication is enabled.
